install.selftestNote: If they sound right, the install is done.
install.removeBody: Removes the model files and its environment. You'll need to download it again to use it. Audio you made is not removed.
install.keepsGoing: The download continues if you go to another screen.
install.deleteBody: Deletes the files downloaded so far. To use the model you'll need to start over.

failHelp.permission: Add the Sori Studio model folder as an exception in your antivirus or security program, then try again.
failHelp.driver: Update your NVIDIA graphics driver to the latest version, then try again.
failHelp.wsl: Turn on WSL2 as shown on the model page, then try again.
failHelp.dependency: Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps failing, copy the log and let us know.

run.deadTitle: It stopped several times, so it wasn't restarted automatically.
run.logNote: Your user folder paths are hidden.

catalog.onlyHere: Only ones that run on this PC

hidden.other: Also show {n} models that won't run on this PC

installed.title: My models
installed.emptyBody: Pick a model that runs on this PC from the Models screen.

try.title: Make speech
try.placeholder: Type the Korean text to read here.
try.firstLoad: The first time takes a little longer while the model loads.
try.serverLoad: This model can take a few minutes to start the first time. It's fast after that.
try.emptyBody: Download a model and you can turn text into speech right here.
try.resultMeta: {audio} s of audio · made in {gen} s
try.tooLong: You can enter up to {max} characters at a time.
try.suspect: The length looks off for this text. Extra words may have slipped in or something was cut. Listen, and press [Make] once more if needed.

retried.one: The length looked off, so it was remade once.
retried.other: The length looked off, so it was remade {n} times.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modelsFolderBody: Where model files are kept. One model takes about 0.5-28 GB.
settings.modelsLocked: You already have models downloaded, so this can't be changed now.
settings.apiBody: Lets other apps make speech with the models on this PC. Works like the OpenAI API.
settings.apiRotateBody: Apps using the current key will need the new one.
settings.apiCallsEmpty: No other app has called it yet.
settings.apiOnlyHere: Only apps on this PC can call it (127.0.0.1).
settings.apiNoInstall: Installing and removing aren't available through the API. Use the app screens for that.
settings.netBody: Nothing about your usage is sent anywhere. The internet is used only to download models.
settings.net1: Downloading models - only when you press [Download]. Models come from Hugging Face; required programs from PyPI, PyTorch and GitHub.
settings.net2: Only the first time you download a WSL2 model - the official Ubuntu image and, if needed, NVIDIA's official CUDA. [Turn on WSL2] downloads Microsoft's official installer.
settings.net3: Nothing else uses the internet. No usage data or error reports are sent.
settings.diagNote: Paste it when you report a problem. It doesn't include keys or your user folder path.

wizard.s1Title: What will you use it for?
wizard.pcGpu: We'll recommend models that run on this PC's graphics card ({gpu}).
wizard.pcNoGpu: This PC has no GPU, so we'll recommend light models that run on the CPU.
wizard.mac: Not tested on Mac yet. Install a model to listen and check for yourself.
wizard.noneYet: No model for this use runs on this PC yet. Try starting with 'Light and fast'.
wizard.s3Wait: You can listen here once the download finishes.

wsl.needTitle: This model needs Windows' Linux feature (WSL2).
wsl.needBody: You only need to turn it on once. Pressing [Turn on WSL2] shows a Windows confirmation, and you'll need to restart your PC afterwards.
wsl.virtOff: Virtualization is off on this PC, so WSL2 can't be turned on. Restart, turn on virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) in the BIOS (UEFI) settings, then try again.
wsl.installedRestart: WSL2 is on. Restart your PC, open Sori Studio, and press [Download] for this model again.
wsl.installFailed: Couldn't turn on WSL2. Please check that you allowed administrator permission.
wsl.manual: Run the command below once in an administrator PowerShell, then restart your PC.
wsl.noDistro: The first download sets up a Linux just for Sori Studio (about 400 MB). Your other Linux installs aren't touched.
wsl.badgeTip: On Windows, WSL2 (the Linux feature) must be turned on once.

gate.title: Connect to Sori Studio
gate.body: Paste the contents of the hub-token file in this PC's Sori Studio folder.

down.title: Can't connect to Sori Studio.
down.body: We'll try again shortly. If it keeps failing, reopen Sori Studio.
down.readonly: Until then the screens are view-only.
